mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by > 2% QoQ

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, which puts upward pressure on wages and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines by > 0.5pp in 3 months

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of INDPRO and SPX 60-day returns remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, which raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.5pp in 3 months

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by > 2% MoM

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts signals a strong housing sector, which boosts related industries and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of HOUST and SPX 60-day returns remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in CPI inflation signals rising price pressures, which erodes consumer purchasing power and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5pp in 3 months

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 200k in 3 months
